aggregation.within_map: Median across batch per-call means; deterministic counters counted once per map.
aggregation.across_maps: Independent maps; official excluded from random groups. IQR is dispersion, not a confidence interval.
aggregation.paired: Effects within maps first: h0/new for baseline comparisons, original/optimized for implementation speedup; optimized one-step/optimized two-step for depth choice. Then aggregate.
aggregation.time_scope: Fresh query preparation and heuristic construction are charged; heuristic evaluation/cache work is inside search. API includes both plus collection and release.
aggregation.memory_scope: Physical heap entries only; heuristic caches are excluded.

heuristic_strength_reference: All variants are compared with h0 for dominance/strict improvement; both two-step variants also dominate optimized h1.

representative_trace.selection_rule: Baseline valid pops closest to random-map median; ties by instance_id.
